# Bug triage — 2026-10-28

Scope: the 15 open bug reports in [jpdagostin0/jimpactor](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Abug). These reports consolidate older upstream reports; a code fix is not confirmation that every historical environment now works. No live Apple authentication, certificate revocation, or app installation was performed during this pass.

| Issue | Finding and change | Validation / remaining evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [#3](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/3) | Preserve Apple's already-sent SMS challenge and selected phone; stop guessing phone ID 1. Fall back to trusted-device delivery when SMS has no available numbers. Preserve lockout and service status codes. | Fixtures cover HTTP 201, explicit phone selection, malformed/locked challenges, delivery cooldown, and 403/423/429/500. End-to-end Apple 2FA still needs an affected account. |
| [#4](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/4) | Header lookup lowercased identity values and client-info was rewritten. Preserve provider values, client-info, and User-Agent throughout SRP/2FA/token authentication; report HTML/malformed responses without panicking. | Identity and malformed response regressions pass. The configured provider and persisted provisioning identity remain in use. Live rejection codes require an affected account. |
| [#5](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/5) | Preserve Apple's error code even without a message. Replace unchecked SRP/session parsing and anisette refresh panics with returned errors; the login window already resets on failure. | Tests cover -22406 and malformed responses. No evidence that a particular Apple-side -22406/-27592 rejection can be bypassed; retain this report for live reproduction. |
| [#6](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/6) | Check v3 HTTP status before JSON decoding, preserve both v3/v1 fallback errors, and include transport source causes with the endpoint origin. Existing system proxy/native certificate support is retained. | Local HTTP 503, transport error redaction, and both protocol fallback tests pass. A corporate proxy/TLS environment was not available. |
| [#7](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/7) | Log the startup version/platform and show a startup error dialog with the log path when the renderer returns an error. | Windows compilation passes. The reported native msvcrt.dll access violation is not reproduced or fixed; a crash dump and matching binary/symbols are required. |
| [#8](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/8) | Add USB trust/service recovery instructions to missing PairRecordData and SavePairRecord failures. Discovery already reconnects after service loss in cb5b5d1. | Discovery protocol tests cover service disconnect, reconnect, pending name lookup, and detach races. Actual Apple service pairing failures still need hardware reproduction. |
| [#9](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/9) | Remove the fallback to an unrelated profile. Prefer an exact bundle match over a wildcard; validate expiration, team consistency, certificate inclusion, destination UDID, and executable presence before transfer. | Profile mismatch/expiration fixtures and existing offline signing integration tests pass. Device-reported entitlement/signature mismatches may still need the failing IPA/profile. |
| [#10](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/10) | Reject expired/not-yet-valid or mismatched certificate/key identities before signing in both signing paths. Skip expired/revoked identities returned by the legacy developer API. | Generated certificate/key tests and offline signing integration pass. An offline imported identity cannot establish Apple's current revocation status. |
| [#11](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/11) | Propagate PKCS#12 creation and worker/save failures to the UI. Write directly to the selected destination, avoiding same-file copies and an extra unencrypted export in app data. | Generated certificate/private-key PKCS#12 round trip passes with the export password (empty). Native save dialog and live certificate retrieval remain manual checks. |
| [#12](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/12) | Add sign --team-id; reject ambiguous nonterminal team selection. Newly added multi-team GUI accounts require a deliberate choice in Settings before signing/export/developer actions. | Tests cover explicit, missing, invalid, sole, empty, and interactive team choices; CLI help exposes the option. Existing saved team choices are preserved. |
| [#13](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/13) | Convert the remaining package tweak, folder, icon, and entitlement pickers to awaited AsyncFileDialog calls. | All-target Windows compilation passes; macOS drag-over-picker reproduction remains a manual platform check. |
| [#14](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/14) | Update the refresh device's account and replace its existing app record only after a successful installation. | Regression serializes/reloads a reinstall under a different account and checks that the app is not duplicated. Refresh ownership remains per device, as in the existing data model. |
| [#15](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/15) | Preflight Mach-O layouts before app modification/provisioning and identify the unsupported file with guidance to use an unpatched decrypted IPA. | A real Mach-O is signed, given trailing linkedit data, and rejected without modification. Relocating CoreTrust trailing data is intentionally unsupported. |
| [#27](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/27) | Recover valid UTF-8 ZIP names when the language flag is missing by normalizing only the staged archive. Keep the ZIP library's legacy decoding otherwise. | Japanese app and Chinese resource paths survive extraction and repacking with missing UTF-8 flags; source IPA bytes remain unchanged. |
| [#28](https://github.com/jpdagostin0/jimpactor/issues/28) | Compare --udid with the stable UDID rather than the transient usbmuxd DeviceID. Remove references to the unavailable --mac option from the Windows/Linux command schema. | Regression reconnects a fixture phone under a different DeviceID and rejects a numeric DeviceID argument; the complete CLI schema and device argument parse are tested. |

Validation commands:

```sh
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked
cargo test --workspace --locked
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo run --locked -p jimpactor-cli -- sign --help
cargo run --locked -p jimpactor-cli -- device --help
```

Live-device tests remain opt-in. GitHub reports are left open where live-account, hardware, or platform verification is still needed.
